reasoning_content: Alright, let's generate the token service key and start the stack. I'll run the key generation and then start the stack in detached mode with a long timeout, while logging the output.

action.command: cd /workspace/deploy/compose/example/local && openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -outform PEM -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096 | openssl rsa -traditional -out ../../config/token_service_key.pem 2>/dev/null && chmod 644 ../../config/token_service_key.pem && ls -la ../../config/token_service_key.pem && head -1 ../../config/token_service_key.pem
